rules.reason: BLOCKED: do not delete anything under <repo>/scratch/. Probe scripts, analysis drivers, and campaign artifacts are meant to accumulate there: the directory is gitignored, quality-gated, rg-searchable, and archived at SessionEnd, so a leftover probe costs nothing and a deleted one destroys evidence. Leave the file in place and move on.
rules.suggestion: Just leave it. If a probe name collides, write the next one under a new name. Genuine cleanup is an operator decision — set INTERLINKED_ALLOW_SCRATCH_DELETE=1 for one command if you have been told to.

file_reminders.message: REPO-SPECIFIC: major CLI behavior, harness policy, configuration/default, client, baseline, architecture, or operator-workflow changes MUST include a skill-impact review. Update every affected skills/*/SKILL.md in the same change; .agents/skills is only an installed copy. If none is affected, state why in the final handoff.
